title: Await settings validation before application startup completes
goal: Await service-dependent settings checks during supported host startup, with explicit synchronous access and reload restrictions.

selectionNotes: Built-in async startup requires the built-in factory and default IOptions; custom legacy IStartupValidator suppresses async startup.
Async-only validators fail synchronous pre-start, snapshot/factory and monitor reload paths; adding a succeeding sync validator does not undo that failure.
Choose generated or handwritten synchronous Validate ownership; RC2 rejects conflicting explicit ownership with SYSLIB1205.
